subject: physics
content: Which of the following statement is correct?

options.content: In primary rainbow, observer sees red colour on the top and violet on the bottom
In primary rainbow, observer sees violet colour on the top and red on the bottom
In primary rainbow, light wave suffers total internal reflection twice before coming out of water drops.
Primary rainbow is less bright than secondary rainbow.

explanation: In primary rainbow, observer sees red colour on the top and violet on the bottom.
